description: Metadata for public Tsinghua Institute for AI Industry Research research and news pages. Hosts are air.tsinghua.edu.cn and www.air.tsinghua.edu.cn. Publisher is Tsinghua Institute for AI Industry Research. www.air.tsinghua.edu.cn does not resolve. air.tsinghua.edu.cn completed TLS. robots.txt on air.tsinghua.edu.cn was an HTML document in place of robots.txt, so research and news pages were not fetched. A Cloudflare, cookie, or captcha challenge, or a redirect off these hosts, is not stored. The catalog is empty. Person profiles, login walls, PDFs, and off-host redirects are omitted. Rows store a title, publisher, canonical URL, publication date, and rights. Page text is not stored. creative_commons_attribution means CC BY alone. creative_commons means CC0, CC BY-SA, or a permissive mix of those. A missing publication date is unknown. A year-only date stays unknown. Updated, modified, and copyright years are not publication dates. This catalog is not a belief collector and runner_wired is false.
